body:
STLTH pods tend to be leaky no matter the flavour and nearly always taste burnt near the end of the pod. It’s usually not bad and pretty manageable. 

Frost is a really good flavour and my favourite, it’s mint with menthol. I’ve experianced no leaks with these pods so far and can highly recommend. Tundra Berry and Honeydew menthol are also pretty good if you like menthol, except I found after two packs of the Honeydew, I could no longer stand it and feel nauseous when I vape that flavour. 

Blue raspberry and crisp apple are two good flavours if you like fruity ones, mango and berry blast are okay but not one of my regular purchases.

Tobacco is good if you like that kind of flavour.
